subject: Publicity & logo use — MSA redlines and coordination
messages:
From: Emma Soto <emma.soto@cumulus.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cumulus.ai
Date: 2028-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MSA — publicity, logo use and redlines

Hi Ben,

Attached are the MSA redlines our legal team has proposed. We're specifically highlighting concerns in Section 7 (Publicity) and Section 12 (Confidentiality). Two asks from our side:

1) We need explicit guardrails around press releases and logo usage (size, placement, trademark notice).
2) We prefer a 30-day embargo on public announcements after contract signature and a requirement that quotes/press releases be approved in writing.

Can Redwood share your standard language for publicity and any examples of press approval workflows? Our marketing lead (cc'd) would like to understand the turnaround time.

Thanks,

Emma Soto
Senior Counsel
Cumulus AI
[Attachment: Cumulus_MSA_Redlines.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Soto <emma.soto@cumulus.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-21T11:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA — publicity, logo use and redlines

Emma,

Thanks for sending these over — received. Looping in our legal lead Lauren so she can propose a clean redline and call out any hard lines.

Quick answers while we review:
- We typically require written approval for quotes and press releases; logos are allowed for customer lists and press with a short trademark notice.
- Embargo windows are negotiable; I'll flag the 30-day request for legal/marketing.

Can we schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow for legal + marketing to align? I've proposed times below — if none work please send availability.

Best,

Ben Carter
Senior Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Emma Soto <emma.soto@cumulus.ai>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-22T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA — publicity, logo use and redlines

Hi Emma / Ben,

I reviewed Cumulus's redlines and here are our proposed positions for Section 7 (Publicity) and Section 12 (Confidentiality):

- Publicity: Redwood can request to be identified as a customer in case studies and press releases, but we will not claim any perpetual rights. We propose the following compromise clause:

"Customer grants Redwood a non-exclusive, revocable right to use Customer's name and logo solely to identify Customer as a Redwood customer in marketing materials and on Redwood's website. Any press release or public quote referencing Customer will be subject to Customer's prior written approval (which shall not be unreasonably withheld) and Redwood shall provide a draft for review at least ten (10) business days prior to publication."

- Logo usage: Logo use limited to specified artwork, with basic trademark attribution. Logo files may only be used in approved layouts; commercial endorsements are not permitted without additional written permission.

- Embargo/timing: We can accept a 30-day embargo but ask that Customer provide a targeted release date during the contract signature process. For urgent joint announcements we can negotiate accelerated sign-off.

- Confidentiality carveouts: We will not claim ownership of Customer data; confidentiality exceptions are standard (required disclosures, aggregate anonymized metrics). We'll flag any overly broad carveouts in your redline.

Next steps:
1) I've attached a doc with inline redlines for Section 7 & 12 (Redwood_MSA_Publicity_Suggested_Redline.docx).
2) Proposed 30-min sync today at 11:00 PT or tomorrow 10:00 PT to finalize wording and agree an MSA edit path.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_MSA_Publicity_Suggested_Redline.docx (docx)]

From: Emma Soto <emma.soto@cumulus.ai>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Cc: tom.li@cumulus.ai
Date: 2028-11-22T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MSA — publicity, logo use and redlines

Lauren,

Thanks for the thoughtful compromise language. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- "Revocable" in practice — can you confirm the process and notice period if Redwood choses to continue using the logo after revocation? We typically expect a 30-day wind-down for live assets.
- Approval window — 10 business days is reasonable for legal/marketing, but our PR team prefers 7 business days for time-sensitive launches. Can we meet in the middle at 8 business days?

I've looped in our marketing contact Tom Li (cc). Tom, we've attached a draft press release and would appreciate a sense of Redwood's typical turnaround for quote review.

Best,

Emma Soto
Senior Counsel
Cumulus AI
[Attachment: Cumulus_Press_Draft_20281121.docx (docx)]

Emma / Team,

- Procurement: Final order form sign-off and countersignature target: 2028-12-01.
